claim: An AWS access portal (user interactive) session lasts for the duration configured in IAM Identity Center, which can be up to 90 days; it ends when the user signs out or an administrator ends it.
question: How long can an IAM Identity Center user interactive (AWS access portal) session last?

qualifiers.condition: duration is configured by the administrator

evidence.quote: User interactive sessions can last for the duration configured in IAM Identity Center, which can be up to 90 days.
They end when the user signs out or when an administrator ends their session.

note: d005 (maximum). Default value: see user-interactive-sessions page. d010: the 7 to 90 days change of 2023-09-12 is only in a What's New post that robots.txt refuses; no history row.
